paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte thu apiak zoh in huai a pan in akhopite uah sinsak ding leh thugen ding in apaita uhi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Misawlte / (Luk 7.18-35)
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

paite: Johan in suangkul sung a Khrist thilhihte ana zak in anungzuite sawl in akiang ah,
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

paite: "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, ahihkeileh midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhiam?" achisak hi.
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uh leh na zak uh Johan kiang ah va hilh un;
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

paite: mittawte amit uh ahong vakta, khebaite khe in ahong pai ua, phakte ahong siangthouta ua, nangongte leng abil uh ahong vakta, misite leng kaihthoh in a-omta ua; mizawngte'n leng tanchinhoih hilh adongta uhi.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

paite: Kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

paite: Huai mite apaitak un, Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agenta hi, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

paite: Ahihkeileh bang en ding pen a paikhia na hita ua? Puannem silh maw? Ngai un, puannem silhte zaw kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

paite: Ahihkeileh bangziak pentak in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei en ding in maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi; zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

paite: "En dih, na ma ah ka thangkou ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampite abawl ding chih atanchin agelh uh hiai mipa ahi.
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

paite: "Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, numei suan lak ah baptispa Johan sang a thupizaw apiang kei; himahleh van-gam a mineupen amah sang in athupizaw hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

paite: Baptispa Johan om a kipan tutan in van-gam in hiamgamna atuak nak, hiamgamte'n thagum in ala uhi.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

paite: Zawlneite tengteng leh Dan thu in Johan ahong om tanpha in ana genkhol zel uhi.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

paite: Na pom nop uleh, huai zaw Elijah hong pai dingpa mah ahi.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

paite: Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen!
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

paite: "Himahleh hiai khangte bang toh ka tehpih dia? Naupang dawr mun a tu a, alawmte sam a,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

paite: tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a, kap huphup ung a, suun lou uchin a, chite bang ahi uh.
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

paite: Johan ahong pai a, ne in adawn kei a, dawi zawl achi uhi.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

paite: Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ne in adawn a, 'En dih ua, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhonte leh mikhialte lawm,' achi uh. Hinapi in athilhih in pilna siam atan uh," achi hi.
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

paite: Huan akisik louh ziak un, athil thupi hihtamna khopite atai hi.
heading: Gingta Lou Khopite Tunggikna / (Luk 10.13-15)
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

paite: "Korazin, na tung agik e; Bethsaida, na tung agik e; noumau a thil thupi kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisikta ding uhi.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak ding sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

paite: Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan a tawisang na hi dia hia? Misikhua tan a paisuk ding na hita ve, nangmah a thil thupitak kihihte Sodom a hih hileh, tutan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in na thuak ding sang in Sodom gam thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

paite: Huchih lai in Jesu'n ahoupih a, "Pa aw, leitung leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na theihsak ziak in ka hon phat hi.
heading: Khrist A Khawlna / (Luk 10.21-22)
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

paite: Ahi, Pa, tua bang hih, nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

paite: Ka Pa'n thil bangkim hon kemsakta; Pa lou in kuamah in Tapa athei kei; Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in akitheihsak utnate kia lou ngal in kuamah in Pa athei kei hi.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

paite: "Nou semgim leh puakgik po tengteng aw, ka kiang ah hong pai un, keima'n khawlna ka hon pe ding hi.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

paite: Ka hakkol pua unla, kei a kipan zil un; thunuailut leh lungtang kingainiamtak ka hi; huchi in na kha ua ding in khawlna na mu ding uh.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

paite: Ka hakkol puak anuam a, ka puakgik leng azang hi," achi hi.
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
